headline: 14 Michigan deals, $26.1M raised — led by Rockwell Medical, Inc.

top_deals.summary: Rockwell Medical, Inc. (RMTI) disclosed a definitive merger/acquisition agreement with Vantive Limited; filing cites a figure of ~$500M.
Cvc Bank Inv, a Grand Rapids-based investment fund, disclosed a $15.1M raise; $12.4M sold to 38 investors. (Amended filing.)
Swan Charlie Opportunity Fund, LLC, a Portage-based residential real estate company, filed a $9.9M debt offering under Rule 504; $0 sold.
ElaiVee Ventures, LLC, a Milford-based company, filed a $6M equity offering under Rule 506(b); $4M sold to 3 investors.
Evenergi Labs Inc., an Ann Arbor-based technology company, filed a $5M options/warrants and security to be acquired offering under Rule 506(b); $4M sold to 6 investors.

new_funds.summary: Cvc Bank Inv, a Grand Rapids-based investment fund, disclosed a $15.1M raise; $12.4M sold to 38 investors. (Amended filing.)

new_funds.company: Northern Shore Capital AAS Co-Invest LP
new_funds.summary: Northern Shore Capital AAS Co-Invest LP, a Bloomfield Hills-based private equity fund, disclosed an open-ended (indefinite) raise; $1.5M sold to 1 investor. (Amended filing.)

notable_ma.summary: Rockwell Medical, Inc. (RMTI) disclosed a definitive merger/acquisition agreement with Vantive Limited; filing cites a figure of ~$500M.
Isabella Bank Corp (ISBA) reported completing an acquisition or disposition of assets involving Grand River Commerce, Inc.

material_agreements.summary: DTE Energy Co (DTE) entered into a material definitive agreement (equity financing).
Workhorse Group Inc. (WKHS) entered into a material definitive agreement (credit facility).
Cooper-Standard Holdings Inc. (CPS) entered into a material definitive agreement.

talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $26.1M sold across 9 Form D filings this week, down 50% vs. the prior 4-week average. The largest was Swan Charlie Opportunity Fund, LLC (Portage, Residential) targeting $9.9M. Good question to ask: are founders in real estate favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?

Rockwell Medical, Inc. (RMTI) disclosed a deal with Vantive Limited. It was one of 2 M&A filings this week. Use it to ask how buyers are valuing Michigan health care & life sciences assets and whether consolidation is accelerating.

2 Michigan-based pooled funds filed Form Ds, reporting $13.9M raised so far — led by Cvc Bank Inv (Other Investment Fund). A natural opener: what are LPs asking Michigan sponsors for in today's fundraising market?
